codesFaq.question: How do I redeem codes?
codesFaq.answer: Open the game, click the settings gear in the top-right, paste your code into the Redeem Code field, and confirm. Codes are case-sensitive.

codesFaq.question: Why do codes stop working?
codesFaq.answer: Codes expire on a schedule set by the developer (usually monthly or tied to update milestones), and some are one-per-account. This page is re-tested regularly.

codesFaq.question: How often are new codes released?
codesFaq.answer: New codes typically arrive with each major game update. Bookmark this page and check back after every patch.

codesFaq.question: Do codes expire?
codesFaq.answer: Yes — most codes have an expiry date, shown next to each code. Expired codes move to the expired table below.

items.question: Is Graveyard Keeper 2 out?
items.answer: Yes — it released on September 22, 2026 for PC (Steam, GOG and Epic Games Store), PlayStation, Xbox and Nintendo Switch.

items.question: Does Graveyard Keeper 2 have redeem codes?
items.answer: No official redeem codes exist for Graveyard Keeper 2. This wiki will never list fake codes; if official codes ever arrive, we will cover them immediately.

items.question: What is new compared to the first Graveyard Keeper?
items.answer: You now play as the Grand Inquisitor: command a zombie army, defend the town with towers, rebuild Emberville, and automate production at factory scale — all in 3D. See our full comparison guide.

items.question: What should I do first in Graveyard Keeper 2?
items.answer: Push your mastery levels, follow the quest line (it gates features), and learn the white and red skull system early. Our beginner guide walks through the first week step by step.
